content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the Task Reporting page","i_want":"to export the filtered, searched and sorted report tasks to an Excel file","so_that":"I can review or share my task data outside the application","business_description":"The Task Reporting page shows the user's tasks in a table with filters, search and sorting. The user needs the same view as a file. The export must contain exactly the rows the report shows for the currently applied filters, search and sort, with clear column headers and consistent date formatting, and the filename must include the time the file was generated.","business_value":"Users can keep a dated, shareable copy of a filtered task view without re-creating the view by hand, which supports reporting outside the application.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The Task Reporting page is open and at least one task is shown in the report table","when":"The user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"An Excel file is downloaded that contains exactly the tasks shown in the report table, with the same number of rows"},{"given":"The report has Status = Open, Priority = High, a search term applied to the title, and a sort by Due Date ascending applied","when":"The user exports the report to Excel","then":"The file contains only tasks with Status Open, Priority High and a title matching the search term, in Due Date ascending order, and no other tasks"},{"given":"The report is filtered so that no tasks match","when":"The user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"No file is downloaded and the page shows a message informing the user that there is no data to export; the exact wording is an open question"},{"given":"An Excel file has been exported from the report","when":"The file is opened","then":"The first row contains a column header for every exported field, and every date cell uses the same date format"},{"given":"A file is exported at a given time","when":"The browser saves the file","then":"The filename contains the timestamp of the moment the export was generated"},{"given":"The export request to the Backend fails","when":"The user clicks the Export to Excel control","then":"No file is downloaded and the page does not show a success state"},{"given":"The team has completed the decision spike on where the Excel file is generated","when":"The export is implemented","then":"The generation location matches the documented decision and the decision record is linked from the story"}],"edge_cases":["The report has no matching tasks: no file is produced and the no-data message is shown (wording open question).","A search term and filters combine so that no tasks match: treated the same as no matching tasks.","The Backend export request fails: no file is downloaded and no success state is shown.","The PRD does not state the date format to use in the Excel file; the format must be confirmed before the file build task is finished.","The PRD does not state the timestamp format for the filename (for example time zone or precision); this is an open question.","The PRD does not state which fields are exported as columns; this is an open question and the default is the fields shown in the report table.","If the decision spike chooses backend generation, the frontend file build task is replaced by the backend generation work defined by the spike."],"dependencies":["US-view-task-report","US-filter-report-tasks","US-search-report-tasks","US-sort-report-tasks"],"definition_of_done":["The Export to Excel control is on the Task Reporting page and is disabled while an export request is in progress","The export uses the existing report endpoint with the currently applied filter, search and sort parameters, not a separate export endpoint","The exported file contains exactly the rows the report returns for those parameters, in the same order","The first row of the file contains a header for every exported column","All date cells use one documented date format","The filename contains the generation timestamp","No file is downloaded and no success state is shown when the request fails or when there is no data","The no-data message is shown when there is no data to export","The decision record for the generation location is linked from the story"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"excel-generation-location-decision","title":"[BE] Decide and document where the Excel file is generated","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Resolve the open decision on whether the Excel file is generated in the frontend or the backend. Document the choice, the rationale and the trade-offs. If the decision is backend generation, document the additional backend work it requires; that work is not created by this story until the decision is recorded. Also document the date format and the filename timestamp format, or record them as open questions for the product owner.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-3a63e0ce"],"derived_reason":"decision_spike","is_spike":true,"definition_of_done":["A decision record states whether the Excel file is generated on the frontend or the backend","The decision record gives the rationale and the trade-offs of the chosen option and the rejected option","The decision record states whether the export reuses the existing report endpoint","The decision record states the date format and the filename timestamp format, or lists them as open questions","The decision record is linked from the story"]},{"key_slug":"export-to-excel-control","title":"[FE] Add Export to Excel control with no-data message to the report page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add the Export to Excel control to the Task Reporting page. On click, request the report data from the existing report endpoint using the currently applied filter, search and sort parameters. If the response has no rows, do not download a file and show a message that there is no data to export. If the request fails, do not download a file and do not show a success state.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-52360b76","R-437992f1"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The Export to Excel control is visible on the Task Reporting page","On click, the request sends the current filter, search and sort parameters to the report endpoint","When the response has no rows, no file is downloaded and the no-data message is shown; the wording is an open question until confirmed","When the request fails, no file is downloaded and no success state is shown, per the constraint that optimistic UI updates are not allowed","Unit tests cover the success, no-data and failure paths"]},{"key_slug":"excel-file-build-and-naming","title":"[FE] Build the Excel file with column headers, one date format and timestamped filename","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Build the Excel file from the rows returned for the current report view. The file has a header row, one consistent date format for all date cells, and a filename that includes the timestamp of the moment the export was generated. This task assumes the decision spike chooses frontend generation.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-09e9d163","R-fad183b1","R-d22b9b6a"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The file contains exactly the rows returned for the applied filter, search and sort, in the returned order","The first row contains a column header for every exported column","Every date cell uses the same date format, as documented in the decision record","The filename contains the generation timestamp in the format documented in the decision record","The file downloads only after a successful response with at least one row"]},{"key_slug":"export-excel-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for the Excel export","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Test the Excel export end to end across filters, search, sorting, file content, filename, no-data handling and backend failure handling.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-52360b76","R-09e9d163","R-fad183b1","R-d22b9b6a","R-437992f1"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests confirm the file contains exactly the rows shown for a filtered and sorted report","Tests confirm a search term combined with filters is reflected in the file","Tests confirm the header row and the single date format in the file","Tests confirm the filename contains the generation timestamp","Tests confirm no file and no success state when there is no data or the request fails","All tests pass in the continuous integration pipeline"]}]}
